title: Hugo front matter v0.165
description: The front matter fields Hugo itself defines, as of 0.165. Hugo requires nothing — a page with no front matter at all builds — so this schema can only ever fail a page on the shape of a value it already carries. That is most of the value: `weight` must be an integer and `draft` a boolean, and the usual way a Hugo page goes quietly wrong is a quoted number or a `draft: "false"` that is true. Custom keys and taxonomy terms such as `tags` and `categories` are user-configured rather than defined by Hugo, so they are tolerated rather than described here. Dates are plain strings on purpose: Hugo parses several layouts, including bare years and Unix timestamps, so a `format` here would reject input Hugo accepts. Hugo's default fence is TOML, whose native dates docmeta normalizes to the string they were written as. See https://gohugo.io/content-management/front-matter/

date.description: A date string. Hugo accepts several layouts, so only the type is checked.

listFlag.description: How the page is listed: a boolean, or one of the three names `build.list` accepts. Kept separate from `renderFlag` because the two options do not share a vocabulary — `local` is meaningful only here, and merging the sets would accept `link` on the wrong one.

renderFlag.description: How the page is rendered: a boolean, or one of the three names `build.render` accepts. `link` is meaningful only here — see `listFlag`.

aliases.description: Page-relative or site-relative paths that redirect to this page.

cascade.description: Values passed down to descendant pages unless overwritten. A map, or an array of maps each carrying a `_target` filter.

date.description: The date associated with the page, typically its creation date.

description.description: Rendered into a meta element for search engines.

draft.description: A draft is not rendered unless `--buildDrafts` is passed. A quoted `"false"` is a string, and every string is truthy — this is the check that catches it.

expiryDate.description: After this date the page is no longer rendered.

headless.description: Makes a leaf bundle headless: its resources stay available but it publishes no page.

isCJKLanguage.description: Counts words the CJK way, which changes summaries and reading time.

keywords.description: Keywords, typically rendered into a meta element.

lastmod.description: The date the page was last modified.

layout.description: A template name overriding the default lookup order.

linkTitle.description: A shorter title for lists and navigation.

markup.description: The content format identifier, such as `md` or `html`.

menus.description: Menus this page joins: one name, several names, or a map giving each entry its own options.

outputs.description: Output formats to render this page in, such as `html` and `json`.

params.description: Custom page parameters, reached as `.Params` in templates.

publishDate.description: Before this date the page is not rendered.

resources.description: Metadata attached to the page's resources. Each entry needs the `src` glob it applies to.

changefreq.description: One of the seven values the sitemap protocol defines. Anything else is ignored by consumers.

sites.description: The sites matrix and its complements.

slug.description: Overrides the final segment of the URL path.

summary.description: An explicit summary, used instead of the one Hugo derives.

title.description: The page title. Not required: Hugo falls back to a title derived from the file name.

translationKey.description: Relates translations of one page across languages.

type.description: The content type, overriding the one derived from the section.

url.description: Overrides the entire URL path, ignoring the file's position in the section tree.

weight.description: Sort weight within a collection; lower sorts first. An integer — a quoted number sorts as a string, which is the classic way a Hugo menu comes out in the wrong order.
